name: Music Mix
description: A long-form music channel. There is no script and no narration: the episode is a mix built from the channel's own music library, under one looping background. Pick ONE world and keep it — the picture is the brand, and a channel that changes worlds is a playlist nobody recognises. Vary the setting, colour and weather instead; every video gets its own background.
exampleTopics: Rain on the window — 1 hour to study to
Slow surf at golden hour — 2 hours

musicFormat.note: Everything below is DATA. Add a world, edit a scene, change the music styles — no code change is needed, and a new pack of worlds is a product you can sell. The PRESENCE of this object is what marks the formula as a music format; `kind` is reserved by the content-pack system and always reads 'series-formula'.
